summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. Support for preserving E-Rate funding and infrastructure for educational access and modernization.

claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate would cut $80,000 annually, impacting classroom staffing
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate covers roughly 80% of our fiber and Wi-Fi costs, about $80,000 a year. Absorbing it locally would cutting two classroom positions.
